title: InstallUtil remote assembly argument
description: Detects an HTTP, HTTPS or FTP positional argument to InstallUtil. Remote strings confined to named installer options are excluded; successful retrieval or execution requires corroborating telemetry.

hypothesis.summary: An adversary may use InstallUtil to retrieve or execute remote .NET content while proxying through a signed Microsoft binary.
hypothesis.rationale: InstallUtil supports installer-specific named parameters as well as assembly arguments. Restricting remote references to positional arguments avoids mistaking a named configuration URL for a remote assembly; this remains a process-level heuristic.
hypothesis.detection_goal: Identify remote URL positional arguments supplied to InstallUtil; exclude URL strings that are only part of named options or local paths.

data_sources.name: Microsoft Defender for Endpoint process events

triage.summary: Inspect the remote reference and .NET installer context; InstallUtil is legitimate but usually should not consume internet-hosted content directly.
steps: Confirm the command's result in follow-on process, file, registry or service telemetry; a process-start event records intent and does not prove successful execution.
Review the complete command, URL, effective original filename, parent process, account and endpoint role.
Correlate the URL with network, file and .NET assembly activity, then inspect downloaded content, signer, hash and installer callbacks.
Confirm a documented development or deployment workflow; otherwise contain the endpoint and investigate the source and follow-on behavior.
false_positives: Approved .NET build, test or deployment workflows that intentionally pass a remote assembly or installer resource to InstallUtil

validation.expected_outcome: Match remote URL positional arguments; reject local assembly paths, named-option-only URLs, unrelated processes and missing commands.

limitations: This single-event signal does not establish malicious intent or successful execution. Renamed binaries, alternate tools, obfuscation and unlogged activity can evade the bounded predicates.
Current-revision evidence is synthetic only. Validate full generated KQL, source fields, ingestion delay, alert volume and scoped exclusions in the target before enabling.
